title: Construct a four-bin relay beyond frozen direct swaps
body:
PR3010 reaches k940 by frozen-source, disjoint direct inverse swaps. This package realizes **k939** using two same-width relay exchanges followed by one inverse swap: six distinct helper roles move through four bins. Every bin keeps its occupied width, and the complete local-plus-idle rank histogram and 91-private-buffer charge stay unchanged. This closes one literal feasibility step for PR2979's changed joint frame/helper inventory; it claims no new kappa or supplier admission.

The source is PR2979 `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`; the starting witness and restricted bound are PR3010 `87ca15cf005ab232ca0104ec5137014ac754f487`. Scientific base main is `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. The new package preserves source notices, exact exports and attribution. Registered provenance resolves the identical frozen exports at this PR’s first commit `64af5a56c7e3aba128161ec215cd909dcfa0fe11`, while preserving original source pins; a fresh full checkout need not contain unrelated open-PR Git heads. `CONSTRUCTION.md` gives the actual roles, strict windows, masks, intermediate stages and all-tariff equality proof.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay and a read-only, Git-free optimized CPython 3.14 replay. The credited primary checker and a separately written implementation check all 135,864 T37 roles, all three journal stages, the exact source T74 order/dispatch embedding and all 271,728 doubled roles. Mathematical defect controls reject omitted roles, illegal chronology, family collisions, mask faults and altered journal claims; a frozen-source byte control also rejects. Deterministic reconstruction reproduces the candidate's canonical payloads. Exact counts and hashes are retained in the receipts. Hosted CI is separate; no workflow rerun or dispatch is requested.

Concurrent PR3018 (`ca7113157d7c959fdfa9d7cd17ef92d3877070d0`) reports a strict moment improvement through the exceptional capacity-48 patterns. This fixed-face relay keeps those patterns unchanged; their composition is unverified.

The general k473 boundary remains unresolved. This result does not establish a new minimum for general allocations or construct every smaller face member. Native phases, arbitrary dirty restoration, complete physical backing/movement, precision/tape, outer and all-size/compiler admission remain inherited. The namespace formula is conditional and is not a physical execution proof. Further tiny neutral relays alone would not demonstrate a larger kappa.

Credit Marius-Paul Dumitrean for PR2979's construction and original face relation; Ross Richardson for PR2987/3010's cut/direct-boundary checks; Yiyang Lu's flow/coloring and the retained Tekalign, Kothe, Dugongue, Hale, Diviney, themilkman216, icekylinx and geometry/native/owner lineage. Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Sol Max assistance and mathematical owner-allocation specialists; Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal-kernel proof is claimed.
